cases.description: The live panel builds the step filter (Whole model, Current model ticked, Ducts, Comments equals mc-live-step) on the Filter tab and reports its count; the filter stays in the panel for the next MCP step
cases.expected: the panel settles and shows a count
manualSteps: Model Context, Whole model, tick Current model; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition Comments equals mc-live-step.

cases.description: After an MCP step (edit, undo, redo, pane hide and show, model switch) the live panel settles and Filter.ResultCount equals MODELS_CONTEXT_EXPECT
manualSteps: Do the Revit step (for example Ctrl+Z), wait until the panel is idle, then read the number before 'matches' on the Filter tab.

cases.description: After an MCP model switch the panel shows the active model: the Current model item of ModelContext.Documents carries that model's title, MODELS_CONTEXT_EXPECT_MODEL
cases.expected: Current model title starts with MODELS_CONTEXT_EXPECT_MODEL
manualSteps: Switch to the other open model (click one of its view tabs): the Revit title bar names it, and the panel's Explorer lists that model's categories under Current model.
